title: ggml-org/ggml
lede: ggml is a plain C/C++ tensor library for machine learning that aims to run models portably and efficiently on almost any hardware, with no external dependencies.

points: Builds for x86, ARM, RISC-V, LoongArch, PowerPC, s390x and WebAssembly, with SIMD kernels on x86, ARM and RISC-V.
Backends span CPU, GPU, NPU and the browser.
Supports 2- to 8-bit integer quantization plus the MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats.
Makes no memory allocations at runtime; its docs also cover the GGUF file format.
Changes to the core library are meant to land as pull requests in llama.cpp, where they get wider review and testing.

points.text: A long-running thread asks for text-to-speech model support.
Users keep asking how to fine-tune models with ggml.
A roadmap item proposes removing BLAS and all its variants, for performance and simpler code.
Requests for more architectures, starting with the RWKV language model.
Questions about the state of the Vulkan backend.
